paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R Part Type: Dual CCV catch can kit, Fluid Lock Part Number: 20-0555-FL

The Radium Engineering Dual CCV Catch Can Kit for the R35 GT-R places a catch can inline between each crankcase vent port and its matching turbo inlet, keeping factory function intact. The kit mounts at the front of the engine and interfaces with the breather lines running from each cylinder head to the turbo intake piping – one can per head.
hl: 10AN ORB Ports: Large inlet and outlet ports
4AN ORB Drain Port: For an optional petcock drain
O-Ring Sealed Dipstick: Check the level without removing the can
Fluid Lock: Radium's patented system stops the reservoir overfilling into the intake
